svg.title: The SomeWM output frame pipeline
svg.desc: Pending state feeds declarations for one dirty output. Clay computes layout in C. SomeWM reconciles the resulting render commands into the retained wlroots scene. wlroots presents that scene. Client applications supply their own surface pixels.

g.text: From pending state to a displayed frame
The layout and rendering path for a dirty output
Lua describes the contents; C assembles one output tree.
Clay computes sizes and positions in C.
SomeWM applies the solved commands to scene nodes.
wlroots renders the scene to the output.
Widgets, bars, popups and client frames share this declaration.
The result is a command array with boxes, clipping and drawing order.
Existing nodes and raster content are reused where unchanged.
Applications supply the pixels inside their own surfaces.
A clean output skips declaration and solving. Active transitions request further frames.
